hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: The n x n grid cells are partitioned into letter Y cells and non-Y cells.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: All Y cells must hold value a, and all non-Y cells must hold value b, where a does not equal b and a, b in {0, 1, 2}.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Count frequencies of 0, 1, 2 in Y cells and non-Y cells. Test all 6 pairs (a, b) with a does not equal b to minimize changes.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass to tally cell types followed by constant 6 checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive brute force over all 3^(n^2) cell states is intractable.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify geometric condition for Y cells and check all 6 distinct assignment pairs.
